name: Lambdas as braced-init-list elements indent under their signature
note: LOGS-5799 (Kamil): a struct initialised with lambda members (PyMappingMethods-style) — each lambda body indents +4 under its signature and '}' aligns with the signature. This is LambdaBodyIndentation: Signature (our default) and the cleanest clang-format produces here; OuterScope regresses it (body loses its indent, '}' drifts to the outer scope). Anonymised reconstruction. https://st.yandex-team.ru/LOGS-5799
